maddeler.e:
عججت (form I)
# عَجَجْتُ (ʕajajtu) /ʕa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
# عَجَجْتَ (ʕajajta) /ʕa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
# عَجَجْتِ (ʕajajti) /ʕa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
# عُجِجْتُ (ʕujijtu) /ʕu.d͡ʒid͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
# عُجِجْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
